I wanted to share files with basically no dependencies. The goal was:  1. Something that didn't require any installation (assuming a web browser)
  2. Have a single file with no network that could self-decrypt
  3. Be fully auditable

The second point is done by having (sort of(*)) reproducible builds and embedded OpenPGP signature
